slides.title: Made for everyone
slides.text: People see, hear, read and move in different ways. A good game works for all of them.
slides.alt: Ana loves puzzle games, but small text is a blur to her. Watch Ana: which moment is she struggling?

focus.cue: Ana: the menu is tiny gray text

slides.title: Every switch is for someone
slides.text: Open a game's settings: captions, read-aloud, text size, contrast. Each switch was made for someone.
slides.alt: Pick two changes that would help Ana: bigger text, a bigger Play button, captions for sounds, read the menu aloud and more.

focus.cue: Bigger text: for people who find it hard to see
Captions: for people who cannot hear
Read the menu aloud: for new readers

slides.title: Help one, help many
slides.text: Captions were made for people who cannot hear. They also help anyone in a noisy room. A change for one person usually helps many.
slides.alt: Pick two changes that would help Ana: bigger text, a bigger Play button, captions for sounds, read the menu aloud and more.

focus.cue: Captions: made for people who cannot hear, and they help in a noisy room

slides.title: Who does it help?
slides.text: Match each change to the people it helps. Most changes help more than one group.
steps: big text: hard to see, bright sun
slides.alt: Pick two changes that would help Ana: bigger text, a bigger Play button, captions for sounds, read the menu aloud and more.

focus.cue: Bigger text: hard to see, bright sun

slides.title: Ask for ideas
slides.text: Ask someone else what they would change. Other people's ideas, called perspectives, spot things you did not think of.
slides.alt: Sol is six and cannot read yet. A box of words pops up: Save your game? Yes or No. Sol taps anywhere and loses.
